pages.title: 同一座城，不同的期待
pages.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create a NEW continuation page of the supplied COLOR MANGA, landscape 16:9, five distinct panels, left-to-right then top-to-bottom reading order. Input image 1 is a STYLE and WORLD reference, not an edit target: preserve the linework, colored manga shading, mature faces, detailed prosperous fantasy city, and faction clothing; replace all panels with the specified new story. Full color, expressive human acting, varied closeups and establishing shots, thin pale gutters. Large legible Traditional Chinese horizontal dialogue balloons with clear tails and exact text. No other text or English or watermark. This is contemporary fantasy BEFORE the peace breaks, not primitive history and not Earth modernity. Long-established civilizations, institutions and organized escorts exist. Kingdom steel/blue/gold armor, Silverleaf green/ivory leaf embroidery pointed ears, Shadowfolk living pale white-haired purple-accented scholars, NOT undead or villains. Do not depict the ancient rustic trio. No murder, culprit, evil adviser, necromancy, war, coronation, vote result, or invented historical revelation. No known hero cameos or new royal faces. Unknown ordinary people may be designed as supporting cast. Architecture and acting carry story rather than a giant prose block.
Title small 「同一座城，不同的期待」. The delegations have entered the civic building after the preceding gate pages; now reveal different hopes WITHOUT falsely making Shadowfolk power hungry. Five panels, full-width top establishing then two middle/two lower.
1. Grand municipal antechamber open to the busy city square. Clerks receive documents from orderly blue human, green Silverleaf, purple Shadowfolk delegations; escorts stay by doors, no ruler or throne visible. A human civic clerk asks the visiting representatives: 「各位對共同統治者，有什麼期待？」
2. Medium two-shot: composed mature Silverleaf female representative in green/ivory leaf formalwear sets a folio on the table, her formal escort behind her. She answers 「別只看眼前，也要想想後代。」
3. White-haired pale male Shadowfolk scholar in purple/silver formal robes calmly closes a book, another scholar and escort listening. His balloon 「我們無意爭權，只希望知識與傳統受到尊重。」 Natural thoughtful expression, not sneer.
4. View through the open doors to families and merchants passing a helmeted Kingdom guard, then near-frame human clerk touches a stack of petitions: 「城裡的人，也盼著日子能安穩。」
5. Broad final composition across the shared table: different hands and documents foreground, three representatives and clerks listening, city visible far behind. The human clerk looks up and asks 「那麼，誰能讓各族都放心？」 Let this question hang. No agreement announced, no claim this is a binding election or exact canonical meeting. It is a small consultation dramatizing existing governance dilemma.

Title small 「王子的分量」. Scene is a quiet established civic archive adjacent to the consultation hall, later the same day. No prince appears physically. Two NEW ordinary supporting characters: young human junior clerk with cropped dark-brown hair, round spectacles, plain navy clerk coat and brass clasp, NOT armor or white fur; mature Silverleaf archivist, male, long brown hair tied low, pointed ears, deep green robe with ivory leaf embroidered stole, no crown. Consistent appearance across five panels. No suggestion either is royalty or hero.
Layout two top panels, two middle panels, one wide bottom panel.
1. Medium archive desk crowded with bound records, a junior clerk looks toward the hallway where envoys are passing. He asks the Silverleaf archivist 「大家提到的，是銀葉王子？」
2. Closeup junior clerk surprised, a formal sealed folder in his hands (no readable invented seal text). 「可是，王子不會太年輕嗎？」
3. Archivist gives a gentle knowing smile, lowers the thick volume onto desk. 「他比一些人類國王，還要年長。」
4. Wider interaction: archivist opens accumulated bound civic records, years of shelves in depth; clerk leans in with genuine new understanding, not comic shock. Archivist says 「重要的不是年歲，是他懂得不同種族，也有治理經驗。」
5. Broad conclusive image: both look through a tall archive window onto the city and moving delegations below, the city is shared not conquered. Junior clerk asks 「所以，他會成為這座城的統治者？」 Archivist replies 「他是重要人選。但還沒有定論。」
No vote, no coronation, no invented specific achievements, no statue or portrait of prince. This page conveys precisely that prince has long life, experience and cross-cultural understanding but is not already appointed.

Title small 「王冠之外」. Shift to Silverleaf royal study in late afternoon, elegant leafy stone arches and living trees, mature established kingdom, no primitive hut. Royal faces and full designs are deliberately NOT finalized: silverleaf king is ALWAYS OFF FRAME; only his aged hand and ivory sleeve with subtle green leaf trim may appear. Do NOT show his head, silhouette, portrait or full body. One ordinary unarmed male adult attendant with brown tied hair, pointed ears and modest green formal robes appears in profile/side-back, without royal ornaments. Convey a calm old ruler interested in scholarship, not weakness, grief or sinister plotting. No crown close-up or elaborate invented heraldry. Dialogue from king uses balloons whose tails visibly exit frame toward the unseen speaker. FIVE PANELS: full-width establishing top, two medium middle, two bottom.
1. Wide shot from inside study toward leafy balcony, books and research notes on desk, attendant at open doorway holding a modest folio. The seated speaker is outside right frame. Attendant asks 「陛下，您仍打算把王位交給王子？」
2. Close-up aged hand calmly closes a governmental folio, another stack of research books nearby. Off-frame king balloon 「他有能力承擔。我也有想完成的事。」
3. Attendant glances down at a travel research journal, brows mildly raised. He asks 「退位之後，去西方？」 Background peaceful garden, not travel already happening.
4. Closeup several scholarly volumes and an aged hand turning a page; only legible book/journal heading 「獄烈戰爭」. Maps if any MUST remain abstract cropped route sketches, NO invented continent geography, no historical battle images, no answers in glowing magic. Off-frame king says 「有些答案，也許還留在獸人長老的記憶裡。」
5. Wide lyrical desk-to-window composition, research journal foreground, sunlit thriving Silverleaf architecture and distant trees, attendant quietly listening on edge, king remains outside frame. Off-frame king concludes 「南方為何能長久統一？我想知道，那場戰爭究竟留下了什麼。」
This is an intention, NOT proof old king abdicated or departed. No ancient mystery resolved, no mysterious race shown, no elemental ghosts, no death prophecy. End with genuine curiosity and a future story thread, not ominous murderer reveal.
